connector.name: Solar Data
connector.registryDescription: US open solar data for agents: PVWatts production, tariffs & ROI, market data, forecasts. 18 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package solar-data-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hoodsy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NREL_API_KEY
env.description: Free key from https://developer.nlr.gov/signup/ — required for production modeling and irradiance tools

env.name: OPENEI_API_KEY
env.description: Free key for URDB utility tariff lookups (economics tools)

env.name: EIA_API_KEY
env.description: Free key for EIA electricity price data (economics tools)

env.name: AHJ_REGISTRY_TOKEN
env.description: Optional SunSpec AHJ Registry token for permitting-authority lookups
